subject: integration conflict: apps/api/pyproject.toml, apps/api/requirements.txt, apps/api/tests/test_migrate.
body:
Rebase onto claude/naadi-shared conflicted in:
- apps/api/pyproject.toml
- apps/api/requirements.txt
- apps/api/tests/test_migrate.py
- apps/api/uv.lock
- config/app_config.yaml
- packages/shared/src/gen/index.ts
- packages/shared/src/gen/sdk.gen.ts

Recent integration commits touching them:
feat(generation): naadi-gen client, quota guard, prompt rules, storage, admin approval, API and health (migration 0022)
feat(notes): notes, highlights, selection toolbar, notebooks with paper templates and whiteboards, PDF export with ink, ink_ocr handwriting search
feat(ink web): server clock offset, adopt clamped copies, quarantine refused ink, fingerprinted block anchors
fix(ink api): echo clamped stamps, integral floats stored as ints, purge horizon (migration 0016)
fix(exam): S09 review - monotonic timer with wall-clock jump detection, shell gates Search/practice on /api/exam/active with Return to exam, S07 shortcut hook, e2e waits for question 41, screens 09/11 in CI scan
S11 rework: plan day limit, number-word guard, diagnostic and coach idempotency
fix(cards): S10 review fixes: no ratings before the card, review-id race, ordered outbox, Stuck? only with a listener
feat(cards): the scratch pad is the card's saved ink surface (S12b useInkLayer('flashcard', card id) + InkSaveStatus, ink settings); Clear asks first; e2e: saved, survives a reload, cleared
chore: rebase onto S10 (0012): contracts, ui_copy defaults, migration chain test includes 0013

My branch is unchanged (rebase aborted).
